items.text: Baltimore QB: Lamar Jackson (right thumb, surgery) is out and headed to IR for at least four weeks; Tyler Huntley (turf toe) is an IR candidate and likely out. Undrafted rookie Joe Fagnano (limited Monday, ankle) will start Thursday per HC Jesse Minter; Kedon Slovis signed to the 53 and Austin Reed to the practice squad.

Baltimore (early week, TBD): LB Roquan Smith (foot), S Jaylinn Hawkins (knee), G Vega Ioane (MCL), RB Justice Hill (groin). Limited: DE Trey Hendrickson, RT Roger Rosengarten, G John Simpson, DT John Jenkins. K Tyler Loop (groin) expected to go on IR. C Ethan Pocic and G Jovaughn Gwyn on IR.

Jacksonville (short week, TBD): RB Bhayshul Tuten (ankle/foot, DNP Monday), RB Chris Rodriguez Jr. (hand), WR Jakobi Meyers (hamstring), DE Travon Walker (ribs), G Ezra Cleveland (knee), S Antonio Johnson (ankle). DT DaVon Hamilton (quad) feared out for the season; LT Anton Harrison and S Eric Murray out for the season. Trevor Lawrence healthy (sat late in 42-7 Week 8 rout).
